# AGENTS.md

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

`bc-harness` — Claude Code plugin (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, v0.4.0, MIT). Commands, subagents and bash scripts that take a project from idea to code: `/init` chain, `/plan` pipeline, `/bugfix` pipeline, `/ai-context` upsert, and `scripts/ralph.sh` autonomous phase execution. Only executable code here is bash (`scripts/*.sh`, 6 files); everything else is Markdown with YAML frontmatter.

## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/test-ralph.sh` | Full `ralph.sh` suite; fake `claude`/`codex` binaries on PATH, zero network, zero tokens; exit 0 = green |
| `scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>` | Run a single case (e.g. `ok-first`, `verify-incomplete`, `resume`, `sail-up`, `split-streams`, `serve`) |
| `RALPH_BIN=/path/to/patched-ralph.sh scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>` | Point the suite at a patched copy to prove red before green (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:13-14`) |
| `scripts/check-shell.sh` | `bash -n` over all scripts + `shellcheck -x` when available |
| `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` | Verbatim anchors for the shared `init:*` rules across `commands/init/*.md` + `commands/init.md` |

- No build step. Scripts ship as-is; no package manager manifest exists (no `package.json`, `composer.json`, `Makefile`).
- No coverage tool.
- No CI config (`.github/` absent). The 4 commands above are the whole gate — run them locally before committing.
- Test suite is one self-contained file, `scripts/test-ralph.sh` (1144 lines, 38 named cases gated by `case_enabled` at `scripts/test-ralph.sh:364`). No `tests/` directory.
- Assertions are hand-rolled: `assert_eq`, `assert_contains`, `assert_not_contains` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:29-42`). Each case runs inside a `mktemp -d` sandbox with `trap 'rm -rf' EXIT` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:17-18`).
- Mocks are injected by `make_mocks()` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:46+`), dispatched by basename; behavior selected by `MOCK_SCENARIO`, `MOCK_STATE`, `MOCK_TEST_CMD`. The mock engine writes progress to stderr and the verdict to stdout on purpose — that is the stream-splitting invariant under test.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

Detail: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

| Rule | Enforcement |
|---|---|
| Every script starts with `#!/usr/bin/env bash` | convention, all 6 `scripts/*.sh` |
| `set -euo pipefail` in the orchestrator | `scripts/ralph.sh:172` |
| Scripts must parse under `bash -n` | `scripts/check-shell.sh:16-25` (always runs) |
| Scripts should pass `shellcheck -x` | `scripts/check-shell.sh:28-40` (optional; absence of shellcheck does not fail the check) |
| Shared `init:*` wording stays byte-identical across the 4 chain files | `scripts/check-init-drift.sh:37-84` (~20 verbatim anchors) |
| `.phases/` runtime state is never committed | `.gitignore:10` + `exclude_phases_dir()` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1079-1090`) |
| Telegram token never literal in a file — env var or 0600 config file | `scripts/notify-telegram.sh:16-20` (`TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`, default `~/.config/ralph-notify/telegram.env`) |

- No `.editorconfig`, ESLint, ruff, Pint, PHPStan or pre-commit hooks. `.gitignore` is the only root dotfile.
- Language split is deliberate — preserve it: `scripts/*.sh` headers, comments and log messages in Portuguese; `README.md` English, `README.pt-BR.md` Portuguese; `agents/*.md` and `commands/*.md` English.
- `commands/init/*.md` duplicate the interview, language, re-run and staleness rules **on purpose**: plugin commands run inside the developer's project where `@`-includes to the plugin root are unreachable. Change a rule → change all 4 files + `commands/init.md`, then re-run `scripts/check-init-drift.sh`.
- Thin routers, agents own the content: `commands/*.md` orchestrate, verify artifacts on disk and report; they never author SPEC/PLAN/docs.
- Trust, but verify: every agent-delivered artifact is mechanically validated by its router (existence, headings, counts).
- Subagents get least-privilege tool grants in frontmatter. `agents/ai-context-inspector.md` is read-only (Read, Glob, Grep, Bash); writer agents get Write/Edit.
- `ralph.sh` invariants (`scripts/ralph.sh:9-18`): fresh self-contained session per phase **and** per correction cycle, zero human interaction, completion decided by the gates never by engine exit code, usage-limit wait re-runs the same phase without spending a cycle, one commit per completed phase (`commit_phase` at `scripts/ralph.sh:2025`).
- Gate contract (`scripts/ralph.sh:1806-2024`): gate 0 engine really finished (claude: `is_error` in JSON; codex: exit code), gate 1 session wrote code (a signal feeding the correction cause, not a verdict), gate 2 project suite run by ralph outside the agent session, gate 3 independent read-only verifier counting **unique** TASK indices where `INCOMPLETE` beats `DONE` at the same index.
- Gate 2 test command resolution, first rule wins (`resolve_test_cmd()`, `scripts/ralph.sh:1145-1192`): `--test-cmd` > `RALPH_TEST_CMD` > manifest detection (Sail → `vendor/bin/sail test`, `composer.json` scripts.test, `php artisan test`, `npm test`, `pytest`, `go test ./...`, `cargo test`) > nothing resolved → loud warning + gate 2 skipped.
- Only stdout is a verdict source; stderr is telemetry (`.phases/logs/<phase>.<step>.log` vs `.phases/logs/<phase>.<step>.stderr.log`, `scripts/ralph.sh:1529-1552`). Measured on codex 0.146.0: 13 B stdout vs 48894 B stderr — merging them broke gate 3.
- `.phases/state.json` (`schema:1`) and `.phases/events.jsonl` are a declared PUBLIC contract with 3 consumers: ANSI panel, web dashboard, external tooling (`scripts/ralph.sh:220-226`). `state_sync()` writes atomically via tmp+mv (`scripts/ralph.sh:371-416`); `state_event()` appends one JSON line per transition (`scripts/ralph.sh:462-484`); `gate_start()`/`gate_end()` emit verdict + duration (`scripts/ralph.sh:493-511`). Changing a key is a breaking change.
- Observability never changes a verdict: logging, notifications, panel and dashboard are a side-effect layer (`scripts/ralph.sh:278-521`). Notifications run fire-and-forget under `timeout`, errors swallowed (`scripts/ralph.sh:297-309`, `:488-491`); 7 events — `run_start`, `phase_done`, `phase_failed`, `limit_hit`, `limit_over`, `limit_abort`, `run_done`.
- ANSI panel degrades, never blocks: `RALPH_UI=auto|panel|plain` falls back to a plain scoreboard on non-TTY (nohup/CI/pipe) and unmounts before any long dump (`scripts/ralph.sh:522-753`).
- Dashboard is local-only: `python3 -m http.server` bound to `127.0.0.1`, first free port from `RALPH_SERVE_PORT` (default 7433), self-contained HTML with no CDN or remote fetch, browser never opened (`scripts/ralph.sh:762-810`, `:812-1020`).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Report gate results as facts: which gate, which phase, which log file under `.phases/logs/`. No optimistic summaries.
- Change a script → run `scripts/check-shell.sh` and `scripts/test-ralph.sh` in the same turn; a new behavior needs a new named case in `scripts/test-ralph.sh`, proven red via `RALPH_BIN` first.
- Edit any `init:*` shared rule → apply it verbatim to all 5 files and re-run `scripts/check-init-drift.sh`.

### Never in this repository

- Never hand-edit a file whose line 3 carries the `/ai-context` ownership banner (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/agents/*.md`) — regenerate via `/bc-harness:ai-context`.
- Never commit a script that fails `bash -n` (`scripts/check-shell.sh:16-25`).
- Never reword an `init:*` rule in a single file — `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` fails on the missing verbatim anchor.
- Never write `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` values into any tracked file; read them from env or the 0600 `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`.
- Never commit `.phases/` (`.gitignore:10`) — it is regenerated runtime state.
- Never make `ralph.sh` prompt a human or decide completion from an engine exit code; both break its stated invariants (`scripts/ralph.sh:9-18`).
- Never let a notification, panel or dashboard failure change a gate verdict or the exit code (`scripts/ralph.sh:278-521`).

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: bash 4+, git, coreutils (`sha256sum`, `cut`, `basename`, `dirname`, `mktemp`), `awk`/`sed`/`grep`; optional `python3` (`--serve` dashboard, `sail-guard.sh` JSON fallback), `jq` (preferred JSON parser), `curl` (Telegram adapter), `shellcheck` (lint).

Install the plugin:

```sh
/plugin install bc-harness
```

`ralph.sh` engine prerequisites (README.md:58-59):

```sh
npm install -g @openai/codex              # codex engine  + OPENAI_API_KEY
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code  # claude engine + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
```

Run the orchestrator from the root of a git repository with a **clean** working tree:

```sh
./ralph.sh [--engine codex|claude] [--from N] [--keep-going] [--max-cycles N] \
           [--no-verify] [--test-cmd "<cmd>"] [--verbose|--quiet] \
           [--ui|--no-ui] [--serve[=PORT]] [phases-file]
```

Exit 0 = every phase green; exit 1 = any phase failed or aborted. Default input resolves to `.spec/init/project-phases.md`, then `.spec/project-phases.md` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1281-1348`).

Local checks:

```sh
scripts/check-shell.sh
scripts/check-init-drift.sh
scripts/test-ralph.sh
```

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| Aborts before phase 1 with "Arvore de trabalho suja" | Working tree dirty; commit or stash (`scripts/ralph.sh:1263`) |
| Aborts with "containers nao estao de pe" | Laravel Sail detected and gate 2 uses `sail`; run `vendor/bin/sail up -d` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1123-1143`) |
| Engine not found | `command -v $ENGINE` fails — install `codex` or `claude` and export the matching API key (`scripts/ralph.sh:1238-1246`) |
| Gate 2 skipped with a loud warning | No test command resolved; pass `--test-cmd "<cmd>"` or set `RALPH_TEST_CMD` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1145-1192`) |
| Recorded progress ignored on resume | Input file changed; `.phases/manifest.txt` stamp `# stamp: <file>@sha256:<12>` no longer matches (`scripts/ralph.sh:1288-1312`) |
| Run stalls on provider quota | `wait_for_reset()` sleeps to the reset epoch and re-runs the same phase; tune `RALPH_MAX_LIMIT_WAITS` (20), `RALPH_LIMIT_WAIT_DEFAULT` (1800), `RALPH_LIMIT_BUFFER` (60) (`scripts/ralph.sh:1629-1726`) |
| Quiet mode looks frozen | `--quiet` is the default; heartbeat prints every `RALPH_HEARTBEAT` seconds (default 60, `0` disables) (`scripts/ralph.sh:1553-1594`) |
| Panel not drawn / garbled | Non-TTY degrades to plain scoreboard; force with `--ui`, disable with `--no-ui`, tune `RALPH_UI_FPS` (default 2) |
| `--serve` prints no URL | `python3` missing (`scripts/ralph.sh:765`); dashboard binds `127.0.0.1` only, URL is `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ui/` |
| Telegram notifications silent | `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD` empty = off; validate with `scripts/notify-telegram.sh --setup` then `--test` |
| Host `php`/`artisan`/`composer`/`mysql` command blocked | `scripts/sail-guard.sh` PreToolUse hook rewrote it to the Sail equivalent; exit 2 = blocked, stderr carries the replacement; fails open when neither `jq` nor `python3` exists |
| Generated `docs/` and `CLAUDE.md` show as untracked | `.gitignore:12` ignores the bare path `docs`, `.gitignore:17` ignores `CLAUDE.md` (leftovers from a removed plugin section) — the repo cannot ship its own generated context tree |
| README mentions `docs/plans/` | Directory does not exist; `docs/` contains only `agents/` (README.md:363 is stale) |

No `.env.example` exists — env var names come from script source. Inputs: `RALPH_TEST_CMD`, `RALPH_VERIFY` (`auto`\|`always`\|`off`), `RALPH_VERIFY_MODEL` (default `haiku` on the claude engine), `RALPH_VERBOSE`, `RALPH_HEARTBEAT`, `RALPH_MAX_CYCLES`, `RALPH_MAX_LIMIT_WAITS`, `RALPH_LIMIT_WAIT_DEFAULT`, `RALPH_LIMIT_BUFFER`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD`, `RALPH_UI`, `RALPH_UI_FPS`, `RALPH_SERVE_PORT`. Exported to the engine session: `RALPH_ENGINE`, `RALPH_PROJECT`, `RALPH_PHASE_TITLE`, `RALPH_PHASE_NUM`, `RALPH_PHASE_TOTAL`, `RALPH_PHASE_ATTEMPT`, `RALPH_PHASE_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, `RALPH_EVENT`. Test-only: `RALPH_BIN`, `MOCK_SCENARIO`, `MOCK_STATE`, `MOCK_TEST_CMD`. Adapter: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_API_BASE`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT`. Engines: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Plugin: `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`.
